risks: Test labels and answer files are private; scoring runs through Codabench.
Public tasks are non-commercial; some source licences restrict redistribution.
Every task needs a dedicated A100 GPU and a two-hour budget.

release.quote: This repository contains the evaluation harness for seven agent scaffolds, the 64 graders, and the scoring and leaderboard code.

redistribution_questions: Does the non-commercial CC BY-NC 4.0 term on the public data block shipping task files inside an adapter image?
May the 101.70 GB public archive be mirrored, or must it be pulled from the Hugging Face release at run time?
How are the access-controlled private answers obtained, and how are they kept out of anything an agent can read?

splits: test inputs (held-out test set with private labels)
tasks.quote: **BioXArena-Pro** is a benchmark of **64 end-to-end biomedical machine-learning tasks in 8 domains** (8 tasks per domain) for autonomous ML agents: given a task description, public training data and test inputs, an agent must write runnable code, train a model within a fixed budget (7,200 s, 1 GPU, 16 CPUs, 96 GB) and submit predictions for the held-out test samples.

verifier.full_credit: No pass/fail: each task's grader returns a higher-is-better score in [0, 1] (reported x100) computed from the submission against the private answers; a failed or invalid run scores 0.

oracle.quote: Test labels and grading assets are not included; they are in the access-controlled repository `mbzuai-ai4bio/BioXArena-Pro-Private`. Public and private files must come from the same release.

services: model API endpoints: OpenAI-compatible/OpenRouter, Anthropic Messages API, Google Gemini API
Codabench competition for scoring hidden-test predictions
network_or_api: the agent's own model API (openai / anthropic / gemini routes); network is open but agents may not look up the source data of a task
credentials: access to mbzuai-ai4bio/BioXArena-Pro-Private (access on request) for scoring
exceptions: Biomni needs its data lake (about 15 GB) via python harness/download_biomni_data.py and BIOMNI_DATA_ROOT
Gemini-protocol runs went through a gateway on a separate machine of the same hardware class: scores comparable, agent times not
Private answers must never be placed where an agent can read them
runtime.quote: | Hardware | **1 GPU, 16 CPU cores, 96 GB RAM** per task (one Slurm job per lane) |
